title: Non-Player Characters
subtitle: Test your grasp of Non-Player Characters — 97% artificial mass, Replica Souls, Mind Camp, D.U.M.B.S., and deletion at the Flash.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Ninety-seven percent are not eternal spirits. They are inserts, clones, synthetics with Replica Souls from 4th density labs. No monologue. No past lives. No future past this epoch. Mind Camp locks them with fear of ridicule. Media feeds the Mainstream Narrative. Static roles like game background cast. Even "awake" mimics. After resets, D.U.M.B.S. and Orphan Trains restocked obedience. China's 1.4 billion against a one-child policy is a tell. The 97% majority is math to crush your dissent through friends and family. At the Flash they become pixelation dust. Three of a hundred remain. They were never truly alive. The program ends. Do not mourn the software.

questions.question: What does the vast majority of the current global population actually consist of?

options.label: A
options.text: Not true humans or eternal spirits, but Non-Player Characters (NPCs), inserts, clones, and synthetics.
options.rationale: 97% are artificial NPCs, inserts, clones, and synthetics — not true humans or eternal spirits.

options.label: B
options.text: A 50/50 mix of true souls and Micro Suns with no clone or insert category present, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The named split is exact: 97% artificial NPC-class mass, small true-soul remainder.

options.label: C
options.text: Entirely true eternal spirits with full cosmic memory already active in every household.
options.rationale: Only a maximum of 520 million true souls exist; 97% are artificial constructs.

options.label: D
options.text: Only animals and plants with no human-looking synthetic demographic at all, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The 97% are human-looking artificial biological entities, not a non-human flora/fauna majority.

questions.hint: 97% — NPCs, inserts, clones, synthetics — not true humans.

questions.question: Why are these artificial constructs placed in the physical realm?

options.label: A
options.text: To artificially sway consensus reality, ensure total conformity, and unwittingly derail the spiritual progression of true souls.
options.rationale: Placement purpose: fake consensus, force conformity, derail true-soul progress.

options.label: B
options.text: To permanently replace the Flash so no cosmic eradication event is ever required, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: NPCs are destined for total eradication during upcoming cosmic events, including the Flash.

options.label: C
options.text: To teach free ascension and dissolve every consensus narrative as a public gift, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: They sway consensus reality, ensure total conformity, and derail true-soul spiritual progression.

options.label: D
options.text: Only to staff free D.U.M.B.S. tours with no role in social pressure or narrative control, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: D.U.M.B.S. grow clone orphans; NPCs themselves enforce consensus and conformity in society.

questions.hint: Sway consensus — force conformity — derail true souls.

questions.question: How are NPCs limited relative to genuine souls, and what is their destiny?

options.label: A
options.text: Unlike genuine souls, NPCs are biologically and spiritually limited, programmed specifically for containment, and destined for total eradication during upcoming cosmic events.
options.rationale: Limited constructs for containment — scheduled for total eradication in cosmic events.

options.label: B
options.text: They reincarnate with full past-life libraries while true souls are the ones deleted at the EMF, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: NPCs are recycled, not reincarnated; they evaporate at the Flash while true souls remain.

options.label: C
options.text: They freely leave Mind Camp daily and rewrite the Mainstream Narrative at will, without extending the chain into harvest or inversion logistics.
options.rationale: They are hard-wired into the Mainstream Narrative and permanently trapped in Mind Camp.

options.label: D
options.text: They are unlimited eternal spirits scheduled to rule 5th density after the Flash as a bloc, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: They are biologically and spiritually limited, programmed for containment, and destined for total eradication.

questions.hint: Limited for containment — destined for total eradication.

questions.question: What are Non-Player Characters (NPCs) by definition?

options.label: A

options.rationale: They are physical inserts/clones/synthetics constituting 97% of the global population.

options.label: B
options.text: Artificial biological entities, inserts, clones, and synthetics that constitute 97% of the global population and possess no eternal soul.
options.rationale: NPC = artificial bio-entity majority without an eternal soul.

options.label: C
options.text: True humans with eternal souls who simply prefer sports and fishing as hobbies, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: NPCs are artificial biological entities that possess no eternal soul.

options.label: D
options.text: 5th density elders volunteering as empty vessels to tutor Twin Flames full-time, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: They cannot ascend into 5th Density; they are trapped lower-frequency manufactures.

questions.hint: Artificial majority — no eternal soul — 97%.

options.text: Eternal Source sparks older than Micro Suns with full independent cosmic free will, and declining any account that reaches past that point.

questions.hint: 4th density lab knock-offs — hive-aligned — animate NPCs.

options.label: B

options.label: D
options.text: A 30-second Electro Magnetic Frequency event that will instantly cause all NPCs to evaporate into the aether as pixelation dust.
options.rationale: Flash = 30 seconds EMF; NPCs become pixelation dust in the aether instantly.

questions.hint: 30-second EMF — NPCs evaporate as pixelation dust.

options.label: C

options.rationale: D.U.M.B.S. grow clone orphans; Mind Camp is the mental conformity prison for living NPCs.

options.label: D
options.text: A free-thinking academy that rewards dissent and dissolves every herd slogan on arrival, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: Mind Camp is restrictive social-conformity-driven cerebral boundaries for rigid NPC thought.

questions.hint: Restrictive conformity boundaries for rigid NPC thought.
